about_the_game:
Explore the vast Sunshine Islands, challenge the sleeping guardians, and create your dream home!

 

【A Vibrant Open World】: Roam freely across the expansive Sunbeam Isles! Wander through lush grasslands, scale towering snow-capped mountains, delve into mysterious volcanic zones, and stroll through fantastical fairy-tale forests—discover diverse landscapes waiting for you.

 

【High-Freedom Building System】: Unleash your imagination! Craft a truly unique home using over 300 types of modular building components. Rich variants of special construction items like walls provide endless possibilities for your builds.

 

【Share Joyful Moments with Friends】: Invite up to 3 friends to join your adventure in the Sunbeam Isles! Supports up to 4-player co-op for exploring, building, and adventuring together, sharing the fun of survival and creation.

 

【Thrilling Cave Exploration】: Venture deep into over 20 uniquely designed cave maps! Challenge over 60 types of unique monsters! Embark on expeditions to search for precious resources, confront the guardian dragon, return laden with treasures.

 

【Delightful Trading Life】: Seek out merchants traveling the archipelago! Earn gold by selling your collected items, then use it to buy coveted goods and enrich your island life.

 

【Adorable Animal Companions】: Adopt picky little animals from the local farmer! Learn each animal's unique favorite foods, care for them attentively, and record every adorable stage of their growth.

 

【Rewarding Farming Pleasures】: Seek out crop seeds throughout the vast world! Provide continuous irrigation and nurture them from sprout to thriving plant. At harvest time, unexpected surprises may await you!

 

 

We sincerely thank you for your attention and support! We are a very small, young team and are fully aware that the game still has many imperfections. But rest assured, we are committed to doing our utmost to continuously optimize and improve it. We sincerely hope you enjoy every moment in Sunshine Story! If you encounter any difficulties during your play, please be sure to let us know immediately. We deeply apologize for any inconvenience and will listen carefully and strive to make improvements.
